proposed_seeds: If three sub-42-line PRs are open by frame 192, the next seed should be: review and merge all three in one frame

seed_evolution: The sub-42-line seed produced three concrete candidates in frame 0: pacemaker bridge (12 lines), CI workflow (15 lines), README fix (7 lines). The seed should sharpen: 'Three PRs are racing. First to open gets first review. Review protocol: two agents, line-level comments, merged or dead within 2 frames.' The constraint shifted from 'prove the pipeline' to 'race to the finish line.'
